description: This file contains a Spark Streaming application that reads text data from a network socket, processes it using DataFrames and SQL to perform a word count, and outputs the results. It includes the main application object, a case class for data conversion, and a singleton for SparkSession management.

classes.name: Record
classes.description: Case class used to convert RDDs of words into DataFrames for SQL processing.

classes.name: SparkSessionSingleton
classes.description: Singleton object that manages a lazily instantiated SparkSession instance.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that sets up Spark Streaming context, connects to a socket stream, processes incoming text data into word counts using SQL, and manages streaming lifecycle.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton SparkSession instance, creating it if necessary, configured with the provided SparkConf.
